sim.timeline.control.description: Explicit play, pause or stop. Stop rewinds physics and awaits pending native render/writer completion, including writer finalization and capture-settings restoration. The five-second timeout is cooperative, not a hard deadline for native calls. Play only observes a pending Stop; TIMELINE_BUSY or TIMELINE_INTERRUPTED requires inspection and explicit retry, never automatic replay. Leases the session edit target for physics writeback and restores it on Stop. Never pumps the Kit update loop; exact stepping uses sim.simulation.step.

sim.stage.save.description: Export a flattened copy, including session edits, to a new basename ending .usda in configured output root. Never overwrite or switch the current stage. Paused Newton copies runtime rigid-body poses into the export only (<=256 bodies), not a solver checkpoint. External texture paths remain dependencies. Process-bound SyntheticData pipelines and pack render products are omitted from the copy; cameras, LiDAR definitions and user graphs remain. Unknown native pipeline content refuses save.

reset_camera_render_handles.description: Explicitly remove validated session-only ROS camera viewportHandle fields from the copy so native textures can rebuild after restart. Default false refuses affected saves; true still refuses authored, ambiguous, connected or unavailable bindings. Originals and live stage are unchanged; omitted property paths are returned. This is export policy, not proof of authorship.

sim.viewport.frame.description: Select and frame visible geometry in the selected stage's active viewport. Edits the active camera in the session layer, preserving source layers and the prior edit target; no Kit undo entry. Refuses mismatched contexts, look-through targets, unsafe session-sublayer camera opinions and empty bounds. Does not wait for rendered pixels or prove visibility; allow ordinary render updates, then capture the verified app window using screenshot. Select a smaller subtree if surrounding geometry occludes it.
